notes.author: Suresh
notes.text: camp setup done, tents up on flat ground nr N hill. gen running ok

notes.author: Ravi
notes.text: Water src A found at base of N Hill, approx 400m from camp. Looks clear, no odour. OK to use for wash + cooking.

notes.author: Kavya
notes.text: src A water tastes fine, filled 3 jerrycans

notes.author: Meera
notes.text: STOP using Src A. Test strip positive - contaminated, diesel sheen upstream. Boil/bottled only till new src.

notes.author: Imran
notes.text: saw oil drums leaking uphill of src A near N Hill track

notes.author: Ravi
notes.text: Found clean creek east of camp (East Creek), Src B. Tested w/ strips ok, clear flow. Use B for all water.

notes.author: Meera
notes.text: Src B test OK, chlorine tabs added anyway. Approved for drinking.

notes.author: Suresh
notes.text: gen died 2200, wont restart, belt looks shredded

notes.author: Imran
notes.text: gen belt replaced, ran 30min ok. used spare belt from store box 2

notes.author: Ravi
notes.text: Confirmed gen repaired by Imran, belt swap done, load test ok.

notes.author: Kavya
notes.text: gen still a bit noisy at idle, check tension tmrw

notes.author: Dr. Anil
notes.text: 3 crew c/o stomach cramps + vomiting since am (Suresh, Kavya, Imran). ORS given, rest. Prob the src A jerrycans from D1?

notes.author: Meera
notes.text: Med incident logged. Src A jerrycans discarded. Only Src B water from now.

notes.author: Suresh
notes.text: fuel low, approx 1/4 drum left, ~2 days at current use

notes.author: Ravi
notes.text: Road washout at km 12 after rain, trucks cant pass. Supply drop requested (fuel, food, ORS).

notes.author: Meera
notes.text: Supply drop req sent via sat radio, ETA unknown. Ration water 3L/person/day.
